title: Andy Edwards, Emil Christian and his trumpet-playing brother
summary: Allen asks about local trombonists of the time and Emil Christian; Pecora recalls Emil played bass and had a trumpet-playing brother Frank.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Yeah, I guess Andy Edwards had left. I think, though.
Yeah, well, he left, let's see, oh, I think about two years after I went to the Palace Theater.
Was Emil Christian playing trombone then or trumpet?
Emil Christian. He was playing trombone.
Well, Emil plays trombone, plays bass. Yeah, but at that time, was he playing trombone?
He didn't know he had a brother that played trumpet, a good trumpet boy. I had forgotten his name. Frank. Frank, yeah. See, he knows them all. Let's stop a second and see if he's recording all right.
